title: Seven-Layer Bean Dip with Guacamole, Cheddar and Pico de Gallo
summary: Canned pinto beans are warmed with cumin, chilli and garlic and mashed into a spreadable base, then layered with sour cream, Cheddar, lime guacamole, drained pico de gallo, black olives and spring onions, and served with tortilla chips.
equipment: 20 cm square glass dish or 1.5 l glass bowl

ingredients.item: x 400 g cans pinto beans, drained (about 480 g drained)
fine sea salt or table salt
ripe tomatoes, seeded and finely diced
fine sea salt or table salt

steps.title: Make the pico de gallo
steps.text: Mix the tomato, onion, jalapeño, coriander, lime and salt, rest 15 minutes and drain.

steps.title: Make the bean layer
steps.text: Warm the beans with the spices, garlic and water, then mash with lime juice and cool.

steps.title: Make the guacamole
steps.text: Mash the avocado with lime juice and salt.

steps.title: Layer
steps.text: Spread beans, then sour cream and most of the cheese, then guacamole to the edges.

steps.title: Top
steps.text: Add the drained pico, olives, remaining cheese and spring onions.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Serve with tortilla chips straight away or chill for up to 4 hours.

tips: Drain the pico well or the top layer will weep into the guacamole.
Spread the guacamole right to the edge of the dish to keep air out and stop browning.
A glass dish shows off the layers.
storage: Cover and refrigerate leftovers, and eat within 1 day; the guacamole will darken a little on top. Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
